chunks: Al-Majrūḥ deposited some wealth with Mirdās ibn ʿAlī for the Nāḥiyah, and Mirdās had in his possession some wealth belonging to Tamīm ibn Ḥanẓalah. Then an instruction came to Mirdās: “Dispatch the wealth of Tamīm together with what al-Shīrāzī deposited with you.”

key_terms.الشِّيرَازِيُّ: the one whose deposited wealth was to be sent together with Tamīm’s wealth
key_terms.الْمَجْرُوحُ: the named individual who deposited the wealth
key_terms.تَمِيمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ: the owner of the other funds held by Mirdās
key_terms.لِلنَّاحِيَةِ: for the Nāḥiyah, referring in context to the sacred authority or office of the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.مَالًا: property or funds being held in trust and transmitted
key_terms.مِرْدَاسَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ: the person entrusted with receiving and forwarding the wealth

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show the handling of entrusted wealth for the Nāḥiyah?
ai.summary: This report describes the depositing and forwarding of funds connected to the Nāḥiyah, showing an organized network of financial trust and communication. It reflects the administrative function of the Imam's representation and the careful handling of entrusted wealth.
